description: This is a C# source file defining the DefaultSitemapCacheProvider class, which implements caching functionality for sitemaps using the file system, including methods for retrieving, setting, cleaning, clearing, and listing cache files.

classes.name: DefaultSitemapCacheProvider
classes.description: Implements sitemap cache management using the file system, providing methods to get, set, clean, clear, list, and purge cache files.

methods.name: GetCachedSitemapAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a cached sitemap file resolver for the specified cache file name if it exists.

methods.name: SetSitemapCacheAsync
methods.description: Stores a sitemap stream into a cache file asynchronously.

methods.name: CleanSitemapCacheAsync
methods.description: Removes cache files that are not in the list of valid cache file names.

methods.name: ClearSitemapCacheAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache file if it exists.

methods.name: PurgeAllAsync
methods.description: Deletes all cache files and returns whether any errors occurred.

methods.name: PurgeAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache file and indicates success or failure.

methods.name: ListAsync
methods.description: Lists all cache file names currently stored.
